title: 3 individuals yet to appear before CIDG over Laos drug shipment

blocks.text: Three individuals implicated in a drug shipment intercepted in Laos that was allegedly bound for the Philippines have yet to appear before the Philippine National Police’s Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG), the PNP said Wednesday.
